versions.title: Projects Within Reach
versions.summary: Duskry now keeps projects close while you review activity, makes settings easier to navigate, and keeps every title readable across changing backgrounds.

items.text: Projects are always available in the sidebar, so you can see your workspace without leaving the page.
Drag activity directly from Review onto a sidebar project to organize it in one motion.
Settings are grouped by purpose with clearer descriptions, navigation, and active-page context.
Page titles stay readable over translucent scenes, and the conflicting native macOS title has been removed.

versions.title: A Clearer Way to Review
versions.summary: Reviewing a busy day is now faster, easier to understand, and less disruptive while new activity arrives.

items.text: A new daily overview explains what needs attention and shows tracked time, work blocks, and assignment progress.
Search and focused filters help you find uncertain, unassigned, or already organized activity without scanning the whole day.
Expanded groups stay open when activity refreshes, so you keep your place as the day updates.
Selection, editing, project labels, and keyboard navigation are clearer and easier to use.

versions.title: Updates You Can Trust
versions.summary: Duskry is now more dependable when updating, verifying subscriptions, tracking activity, and handling plan changes.

items.text: Updates stay visible and retryable when a download or installation fails, with clearer platform availability errors.
Paid access is preserved through temporary connection problems while invalid or mismatched licenses still fail safely.
Tracking and reports now handle sleep, crashes, recovery, and activity that crosses midnight more accurately.
Project assignment remains clear after plan changes, and locked projects can no longer receive new activity by mistake.

versions.title: A Steadier, Simpler Workspace
versions.summary: Duskry now keeps open work in place during live updates, simplifies Projects, and strengthens Windows support.

items.text: Expanded work blocks stay open while fresh activity data arrives.
Projects now focuses on project setup and activity; rule management lives in the dedicated Rules page.
Windows 10 uses a consistent dark fallback, while Windows 11 keeps native Mica translucency.
Windows builds are now verified before release alongside the existing frontend and Rust checks.

versions.title: A Clearer Day, Smarter Rules
versions.summary: Duskry now turns busy activity into clear work blocks, makes automation easier to control, and keeps paid access dependable.

items.text: Rapid app switches are grouped into clear work blocks, with the full app mix available when you need it.
Needs attention highlights uncertain activity and suggests likely projects for faster review.
Rules has a dedicated workspace with Off, Ask me, and Autopilot modes, plus clear evidence for learned patterns.
The window now has a calmer translucent treatment.

versions.title: Reliable Subscriptions and Cleaner Activity
versions.summary: Duskry now keeps paid subscriptions refreshed and makes busy days easier to understand.

items.text: Paid licenses now refresh automatically instead of expiring locally after seven days.
Short application switches are grouped into a compact timeline summary.
The Activity page now opens in a minimal Summary view with Details available when needed.

versions.title: Activity Management Improvements
versions.summary: Duskry now makes it much easier to organize, bulk-manage, and review your tracked activities.

items.text: You can now select multiple activities at once and assign them together from the Activity page.
Projects can now be cleared from individual activities or whole selections directly from Activity and Overview.
Dragging a selected activity to a project now assigns the full current selection.
Bulk actions now include quick delete, select all, and cleaner selection controls.

versions.title: Background Scenes and What's New Modal
versions.summary: Duskry now has a richer scenic background system with more customization.

items.text: Added more scenic day, dusk, and night backgrounds.
You can now change both the start time and assigned background for each auto scene slot.
Background selection is smoother with direct hover actions in Appearance.
Added a 'What's New' modal to highlight new features after updates.
